plain: Whether Google can find and walk through every page on your site.
long: If Google's crawler can't discover or access a page, it won't appear in search — no matter how good the content is. We make every important URL discoverable and index-ready.

plain: Tells Google which page is the real one when you have duplicates.
long: When two URLs show similar content, the canonical tag points to the authoritative version so ranking power isn't split and duplicate-content issues are avoided.

plain: A roadmap file that lists every important page for Google.
long: A properly structured sitemap tells crawlers which pages exist, how often they change, and which matter most — so the right pages get prioritized.

plain: A small file that tells crawlers which pages to skip or allow.
long: Misconfigure it and you can block your whole site from Google — or expose pages you meant to hide. We set it to allow what matters and protect what doesn't.

plain: Helps AI like ChatGPT and Perplexity understand and surface your site.
long: An emerging standard that gives large language models a clean summary of your content. Optional today, but increasingly how AI assistants choose what to recommend.

plain: Permanently sends visitors and Google from an old URL to a new one.
long: When a page moves, a 301 redirect preserves link equity and authority so you don't lose rankings — unlike a broken 404.

plain: The ranking power a link passes from one page to another.
long: Not all links are equal. High-authority backlinks and clean internal links pass equity that lifts the linked page in search results.

plain: Everything you optimize on the page itself — titles, headings, and content.
long: Title tags, meta descriptions, header hierarchy, internal links, keyword placement, and structured data all send signals to search engines about what the page is for.

plain: The behind-the-scenes setup that lets Google read and rank your site.
long: Speed, mobile responsiveness, crawlability, HTTPS security, and JavaScript rendering — Google rewards sites that load fast and work flawlessly on every device.

plain: Google's speed and experience scores — how fast your site feels.
long: Metrics like Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) measure load speed and stability. Faster sites rank higher and convert better, especially on mobile.

plain: Google's trust check: Experience, Expertise, Authority, Trust.
long: Content that shows real experience and credible expertise earns trust — and higher rankings — especially for local service businesses where reputation matters.

plain: Hidden code that helps Google understand your content and show rich results.
long: Schema markup describes your business, services, and FAQs in a machine-readable format so Google can show stars, FAQs, and map details in results.

plain: Keeping your Name, Address, Phone identical everywhere online.
long: Mismatched NAP data across directories confuses Google and hurts map rankings. We keep your listings consistent for stronger local visibility.

plain: Your free Google listing that shows calls, reviews, hours, and map position.
long: Often the first thing customers see. We optimize your GBP — photos, posts, Q&A, reviews — so you appear in the top 3 map results where most clicks happen.

plain: The top 3 map results Google shows for local searches.
long: For 'near me' queries, the Map Pack gets the majority of clicks and calls. Local SEO is the work that gets you into those three spots.

plain: Finding the exact words customers type when they need you.
long: We map high-intent search terms, group them by topic and intent, and build pages and content that match what real customers are searching for.

plain: Text that describes an image for Google and screen readers.
long: Alt tags help images rank in Google Images, improve accessibility, and give search engines context when they can't 'see' the picture.

plain: Saves your pages as plain HTML so Google can read them instantly.
long: Many modern sites hide content behind JavaScript that crawlers skip. We output every URL as clean static HTML so every page is crawlable on first load — the core of the SEO Upgrade.

plain: The fast framework we build sites on — built for SEO.
long: Astro ships zero JavaScript by default and renders every page to static HTML at build time. That means faster loads and full indexability without the JS empty-shell problem.

plain: Your web address — e.g., shelbywebco.com.
long: The domain is the name people type to find you. We help secure it, keep it renewed, and point it correctly to your hosting.

plain: Where your website lives on the internet — the server that serves it.
long: Good hosting keeps your site fast, secure, and online. Cheap hosting slows you down and hurts rankings when the server is sluggish or down.

plain: The padlock that makes your site secure — required by Google.
long: SSL encrypts data between visitor and server. Sites without HTTPS show 'Not Secure' warnings and rank lower. We provision and renew it for you.

plain: The system you use to edit your site — without touching code.
long: A content management system lets you update text, photos, and posts yourself. We build on lean, secure setups so you can edit without breaking SEO.

plain: A clear next step that turns a visitor into a lead — Call, Book, Request Quote.
long: A conversion happens when someone takes action. We design prominent calls-to-action and remove friction so more visitors become customers.

plain: How your page addresses are organized — short, clean, and descriptive.
long: Clean URLs like /services/roofing/ are easier for people and Google to understand than long parameter strings. They also help with crawlability and sharing.
